name: groundPos
meaning: ground position the blob is projected to

name: corners
meaning: the two half-diagonals of the projected ground quad (tangent+bitangent, tangent-bitangent); Shadow_Update 0x4726a1 takes one pointer to +8 and writes [0] and [1] through it

name: flags
meaning: 1 = not drawn (Shadow_Render 0x472904), 2 = re-project on the next Shadow_Update, 4 = set by SmallRock_Init/Wolf (SetFlag4) with no known reader; ScnMobile +0x78 = shadow +0x14

name: pad15
meaning: tail padding to the 0x18-byte size used by ScnLogicShadowed +0x40 and ScnMobile +0x64
